hypothesis: Separating message selection from claim extraction, using simple local handles, and letting ordinary code reconstruct exact source text will recover evidence that the overloaded one-call prompt lost.

frozen_input.origin: Two owner-approved failed desktop audit logs

finding: The two-stage interface fixed message identity and placeholder failures. Asking Qwen to retype exact quotes still failed, while selecting source-line coordinates let code reconstruct exact evidence for every returned claim.
limit: This is a two-case development replay, not a locked accuracy result. Qwen still returned extra true-but-unneeded claims, so the question-to-claim relevance stage remains necessary before writing an answer.
next: Test the same contract on a larger frozen mix of answerable and unanswerable questions before integrating it into the desktop application.
privacy: No owner question, message, quote, source identifier, local path, network address, or credential is published. Detailed outputs remain only in owner-private 0600 files.
